content.text: {"id": "mm5303a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In 2002, a total of 36 (71%) Medicaid programs reported offering coverage for at least one form of tobacco-dependence treatment"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "20 (57%) required some form of patient cost sharing"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "20 (57%) required some form of patient cost sharing"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "In 2002, a total of 36 (71%) Medicaid programs reported offering coverage"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In 2002, a total of 36 (71%) Medicaid programs reported offering coverage"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "in 2001, a total of 35 programs offered coverage"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "During 2001--2002, the number of Medicaid programs offering coverage for any form of tobacco-dependence treatments increased slightly."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "all states and DC were surveyed again about the amount and type of coverage"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "During 2001--2002, the number of Medicaid programs offering coverage for any form of tobacco-dependence treatments increased slightly."}]}, {"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "One of the national health objectives for 2010 is to provide coverage"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "So that survey responses could be validated, all Medicaid program respondents were asked to submit a written copy of their coverage policies"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "After additional follow-up was conducted through telephone, e-mail, and fax, the response rate was 100%."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "On basis of response to the question, “Does your state Medicaid program cover any of the following tobacco-dependence treatments?”"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
